title: The Fallen Star
text: A star came down in the night; you saw it fall. It lies at the bottom of a glassy crater, no bigger than a fist, still warm and still singing. Its thin silver note makes your eyes water and your heart ache for something far away.

options.label: Dig the star out of its crater, while it is still warm.

outcomes.text: Its heart of star-metal still sings faintly in the hand. It never quite stops.
Something else came down with it. It has been waiting at the bottom of the crater.

options.label: Sit and listen to it sing, and let it remind you of something far away.

outcomes.text: All night it sings of the sky it fell from. You weep without knowing why, and feel better for it.

options.label: The boldest touches the star, longing to know what it feels like.

outcomes.text: Starlight enters their blood, bright and cold, and it stays.
Too much starlight floods in, burning them from the inside out.
